segments.thag1.79:1.1: “Sabbo rāgo pahīno me, sabbo doso samūhato;
segments.thag1.79:1.3: Sabbo me vigato moho, sītibhūtosmi nibbuto”ti.

lines: Sabbo me vigato mohoti “dukkhe aññāṇan”tiādinā (dha. sa.1067; vibha.909) vatthubhedena aṭṭhabhedo, saṃkilesavatthuvibhāgena anekavibhāgo sabbopi moho maggena viddhaṃsitattā mayhaṃ vigato.

Sītibhūtosmi nibbutoti evaṃ mūlakilesappahānena tadekaṭṭhatāya saṃkilesānaṃ sammadeva paṭippassaddhattā anavasesakilesadarathapariḷāhābhāvato sītibhāvaṃ patto, tato eva sabbaso kilesaparinibbānena parinibbuto ahaṃ asmi bhavāmīti aññaṃ byākāsi.
